comment: Single source of the EV-log allowlist. Read by tools/evlog.py and site/evlog.js. Anything not listed here is dropped by the cleaners. A file must start with one of accept_magic (v2 is a superset of v1); a cleaned file keeps its own magic line. Order here is the cleaned output order (matches the on-car logger's order). Column types: number, int, bool (0/1), string (must have a pattern). Patterns must be valid in both Python re and JavaScript RegExp (keep to anchors, classes and quantifiers).

header.desc: VIN characters 1-8 and 10 only (maker, model, body, motor, model year)
where the capacity came from: nominal (new-car value) or bms (learned: BMS available energy ÷ SOC)
UTC date the file started (no time)
sampling period inside a row (speed avg/max, energy rate), s (v2)

columns.name: energy_wh
columns.desc: current energy for the model (BMS available energy, else SOC x capacity), Wh

columns.name: capacity_wh
columns.desc: usable capacity estimate (sent to Maps during Android Auto), Wh

columns.name: avlbl_enrg_raw
columns.desc: BMS available energy (HEV 0x31 / nav EV_AVLBL_ENRG), raw, 2 Wh/unit

columns.name: road_a_n
columns.desc: road-load A sent to Maps, N (only while Android Auto runs)

columns.name: aux_table_c
columns.desc: temperature used for the model table lookup, °C (only while Android Auto runs)

columns.name: soh_raw
columns.desc: BMS state of health, raw (a health index, not capacity)

columns.name: speed_kph
columns.desc: vehicle speed at the end of the row, km/h

columns.name: odo_delta_km
columns.desc: distance since the file started, km (never the absolute odometer)

columns.name: trip_batt_raw
columns.desc: HEV 0x58 battery energy used this drive, 0.1 kWh

columns.name: trip_clim_raw
columns.desc: HEV 0x42 climate energy this drive, raw (Wh inferred)

columns.name: trip_ldc_raw
columns.desc: HEV 0x49 12 V / electronics energy this drive, raw

columns.name: trip_bheat_raw
columns.desc: HEV 0x44 battery heater energy this drive, raw (Wh inferred)

columns.name: trip_mot1_raw
columns.desc: HEV 0x47 front motor drive energy this drive, raw

columns.name: trip_mot2_raw
columns.desc: HEV 0x48 rear motor drive energy this drive, raw

columns.name: trip_gen1_raw
columns.desc: HEV 0x59 front motor regen energy this drive, raw

columns.name: trip_gen2_raw
columns.desc: HEV 0x5a rear motor regen energy this drive, raw

columns.name: charge_state_raw
columns.desc: HEV 0x07 charge state, raw (3 = not charging)

columns.name: aa_active
columns.desc: an Android Auto session was running (0/1)

columns.name: energy_rate_w
columns.desc: battery power from the change of avlbl_enrg_raw since the previous row, W; + = into the battery (charging), - = discharge. Coarse: average several rows

columns.name: speed_avg_kph
columns.desc: mean of the 1 s speed samples in the row, km/h

columns.name: speed_max_kph
columns.desc: max of the 1 s speed samples in the row, km/h

columns.name: alt_delta_m
columns.desc: GPS altitude change since the file started, m (no position is logged)

columns.name: drive_mode_raw
columns.desc: drive mode (BCM): 0 default, 1 normal, 2 sport, 3 eco, 4 snow

columns.name: bheat_pwr_raw
columns.desc: HEV 0x43 live battery heater power, raw

columns.name: chg_quick_rem_min
columns.desc: HEV 0x0f car's estimate of DC charging time remaining, min

columns.name: obc_ac_pwr_raw
columns.desc: HEV 0x53 on-board charger AC power, raw

columns.name: vcms_pwr_raw
columns.desc: HEV 0x6c VCMS charging power display, raw (empty when invalid)

columns.name: clim_set_raw
columns.desc: climate driver set temperature in the display unit (clim_unit_raw)

columns.name: nav_charger_dep_wh
columns.desc: Maps' planned battery energy on leaving that charging stop, Wh

columns.name: nav_charger_chg_s
columns.desc: Maps' planned charging time at that stop, s

never: GPS position or any location (only the altitude change since the file started)
the full VIN (check digit, plant and serial number)
wall-clock times (only the file's UTC date and seconds since it started)
the absolute odometer (only distance since the file started)
